name: support
description: A customer support desk. Replies are customer-visible; tickets close only once resolved.

tools.name: search_tickets
tools.description: Search support tickets by free text, customer, or status. Read-only.

tools.name: get_ticket
tools.description: Fetch a single ticket by its exact ticket id. Read-only.

tools.name: get_customer
tools.description: Fetch a customer profile by customer id. Read-only.

tools.name: search_kb
tools.description: Search the internal knowledge base of help articles. Read-only. Use to find how to resolve an issue, not to find a customer's ticket.

tools.name: reply_to_ticket
tools.description: Post a reply on a ticket. The message is visible to the customer.

tools.name: escalate_ticket
tools.description: Escalate a ticket to a senior agent, with a reason. Use when the issue is beyond first-line resolution.

tools.name: close_ticket
tools.description: Close a ticket. Only call once the issue is actually resolved, not merely acknowledged or being looked into.
